text:
emma: Quick heads-up — Triton EAP kickoff. NDA is signed and uploaded: https://redwood.example/nda/triton-eap. Triton says 4 nodes shipping next week. Need a short bench plan + telemetry schema so we can hand off to lab. @eng-ml @eng-runtime @security, please advise on blockers. Any volunteers to own the run plan? :rocket:

raj: I can own the bench harness and runs. Plan: perf sweep + token-level p95/p99, and a small accuracy/regression check against our eval set. Prefer seq=512 and seq=2048 runs. Need exact GPU model + firmware from Triton.

mei: Triton asked for our KMS public key and audit contact. Also need network wiring/VLAN details for the lab. I'll coordinate with eng-infra and Triton infra. Who can share KMS fingerprint?

anya: I will own the eval prompts and acceptance criteria. Will produce an initial prompt set and regression thresholds by Friday. Going to include hallucination checks + SUT-specific edge cases.

carlos: Logistics update — shipping ETA is Thu next week (carrier: BlueFreight). I've updated the logistics doc: https://redwood.example/docs/triton-shipping. Rack power note: ~6kW/node expected. Need facility signoff for cooling.

infra-bot: Provision ticket #PR-7542 opened for lab slot 2024-11-12 -> 2024-11-19. Assigned: raj, mei.

raj: Minimal benchmark run command I'll use for quick sanity checks (will be in the harness):
```
./run_bench.sh --model=redwood/rw-llama-13b --batch=1 --seq=512 --iters=100 --telemetry-endpoint=https://telemetry.redwood.internal/v1/push
```
Add flags for quantization/amp as needed.

mei: Telemetry schema (short): 
- trace_id
- node_id
- gpu_temp_c
- token_latency_ms
- model_variant
Will post full JSON schema to the doc later. Triton asked for batching behavior details.

emma: Great. To summarize owners: raj = harness & runs, anya = evals & gates, mei = infra & telemetry, carlos = shipping/logistics. I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 10am PT to align on run cadence and NDA redlines. :calendar: 

anya:👍 I'll prep the eval deck and share before the sync.

carlos: :eyes: will confirm rack availability after carrier ETA is final.

emma: Thanks team — goal is first smoke + perf numbers within 7 days of rack up. If blockers pop up, DM me or ping this thread.

raj: Noted. I'll post the harness repo link and a test run log once nodes are in the lab.

mei: KMS fingerprint: SSH-FP: SHA256:abcd... (placeholder) — will replace with real key in the doc.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: calendar invite created for Tue 10:00 PT.

anya: :thumbsup:
